en.headline: CHP investigates new local Mpox case involving 39-year-old man
en.dek: The patient is stable and will continue isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital; high-risk groups are urged to get vaccinated.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a confirmed Mpox case involving a 39-year-old man who developed fever and swollen neck lymph nodes on 24 August, followed by oral lesions and a rash on the face, trunk, limbs and genital area.

He attended a follow-up appointment at Queen Elizabeth Hospital on 26 August for an underlying condition and was admitted for isolation the same day. Laboratory testing confirmed the Monkeypox virus. He is in stable condition and will be transferred to Princess Margaret Hospital.

The patient had not received Mpox vaccination and reported high-risk exposure with two male strangers in Hong Kong during the incubation period. Since 2022 Hong Kong has recorded 97 Mpox cases, all male; the centre is tracing contacts and will notify the World Health Organization.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查39歲男子猴痘確診個案
zh.dek: 患者情況穩定，將轉送瑪嘉烈醫院繼續隔離治療；中心呼籲高風險群組接種疫苗。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日表示正調查一宗猴痘確診個案，涉及一名39歲男子。他於8月24日出現發燒及頸部淋巴結腫大，其後口腔出現潰瘍，面部、軀幹、四肢及生殖器官亦出疹。
他於8月26日因自身疾病到伊利沙伯醫院覆診，同日留院接受隔離及治療。樣本經中心公共衞生化驗服務處化驗後證實感染猴痘。他目前情況穩定，將轉送瑪嘉烈醫院繼續治療。
患者不曾接種猴痘疫苗，潛伏期內曾在香港與兩名陌生男子有高風險接觸。自2022年起本港共錄得97宗猴痘個案，全部為男性。中心正進行流行病學調查並會通報世界衞生組織。
